verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability and improvement platform for AI agents, so scheduling recurring jobs such as periodic evals, reports, or backfills is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows event-driven behavior: real-time signal firing, one-off backfills, CI and live-traffic scoring, and alert routing. None of these is a user-defined recurring schedule. The 'recurring failures' wording refers to grouping repeated failures, not scheduling, and the 'scheduled api-gap-repair workflow' is the evidence-collection tooling, not a Bento feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
